title: Batching
hints: Start a goroutine that ranges over in, appending to the current batch. Each time the batch reaches size, send it and start a new one.
When the range loop ends, in is closed: send any partial batch that's left, then close out.
go func() { defer close(out); var b []string; for s := range in { b = append(b, s); if len(b) == size { out <- b; b = nil } }; if len(b) > 0 { out <- b } }()
